memorial.title: Morozov Volodymyr Serhiyovych
memorial.subtitle: Director of LLC "NVO A.T.O.R."
memorial.p1: It is with unspeakable pain and deep sorrow that we announce that on July 13, 2026, at the age of 53, Volodymyr Serhiyovych Morozov, Director of LLC "NVO A.T.O.R.," passed away.
memorial.p2: This is an irreparable loss for our entire team, for our partners, friends, and everyone who had the good fortune of knowing Volodymyr Serhiyovych. It is hard to accept that the person who was the soul of the company, a source of strength, wisdom, and inspiration, is no longer with us.
memorial.p3: Volodymyr Serhiyovych devoted his whole life to the work he truly loved. Under his leadership, modern, comfortable, and safe interiors were created for railway cars, locomotives, and public transport. His work will forever remain part of thousands of journeys, millions of human stories, and the everyday life of Ukraine's railways.
memorial.p4: From his very first days as Director, he confidently led the company forward. He knew how to see opportunity where others saw difficulty, found solutions even in the most challenging production situations, and never lost faith in people. It was thanks to his professionalism, foresight, diligence, and dedication to his work that LLC "NVO A.T.O.R." became a successful, strong, and united team.
memorial.p5: For each of us, Volodymyr Serhiyovych was far more than a leader. He was a wise mentor, a person with a great heart, who always found time to listen, to support, and to help with good advice or simply a kind word. He knew how to share responsibility, to support us in difficult moments, and to instill confidence even when it seemed there was no way out.
memorial.p6: His warm smile, boundless optimism, and subtle sense of humor will forever remain in our memory. With a single joke he could dispel fatigue, restore hope, bring people together, and remind us that together we can overcome any difficulty. This is how we will always remember him — strong, wise, humane, and sincere.
memorial.p7: We have lost a Person who lived for his work, believed in his team, and gave a piece of his soul to everyone who worked alongside him.
memorial.p8: The bright memory of Volodymyr Serhiyovych will live on not only in our hearts. It will live on in the projects he created, in every railway car he worked on, in the work he left to those who follow him, and in the people he inspired by his own example.
memorial.p9: We extend our most sincere and heartfelt condolences to the family and loved ones of Volodymyr Serhiyovych. We share your unspeakable pain and bow our heads in grief.

direction.title: Work directions
direction.description1: Creation of new types of products both in the direction of passenger car construction and in the direction of general engineering
direction.description2: LLC NVO A.T.O.R. manufactures and supplies a wide range of components for the production of new and major repairs of passenger cars, diesel trains, and electric trains, including interiors and exteriors, and production of shelter-sliding doors, and automatic drive doors.
direction.description3: Electrical equipment for management, control, and diagnostics of power supply systems in passenger cars, control of climate systems, and lighting passenger cars, provides control, control, and diagnosis of car systems in automatic and manual modes.
direction.description4: The enterprise produces ecologically clean toilet complexes of the vacuum type for passenger cars and electric trains, as well as completely ready sanitary modules.
